title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Integrated Nutrition, Health and Food Security and Livelihood programme is implemented by Trócaire in Tobo, Heiban and Dellami counties, aims to contribute to Outcome 4.1: The most vulnerable/marginalised women, men, girls and boys in the communities affected by crisis can meet their basic needs. The activities and objective include, training of health care staff and provision of integrated health and nutrition services, health staff trained so, the vulnerable in the communities are utilising humanitarian assistance that is principled, timely, high quality and in line with their needs and priorities. Programmes are in partnership with, Bishop Gassis Relief and Rescue Foundation (BGRRF). OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome 4.1The most vulnerable/marginalised women, men, girls and boys in the communities affected by crisis can meet their basic needs . SPECIFIC OUTCOME: The principal focus of this objective is:- Improve access to more diversified nutritional diets and food and improve the nutritional status of a target population- Improve access to WASH and nutrition knowledge- ensure that women and girls benefit equally with men from the activity to compensate for past discrimination
